Problem Statement:
Create a Student class and a GraduateStudent class that inherits from Student. 
1. Student should have attributes: name, rollNumber, and marks.
2. GraduateStudent extends Student and adds a thesisTitle attribute.
3. Implement a method to display final grade based on marks:
90-100 → A
75-89 → B
50-74 → C
Below 50 → Fail 
Input Description:
1. A string name
2. An integer rollNumber
3. An integer marks
4. A string thesisTitle 
Output Description:
Print grade and thesis title. 
Sample Input:
Alice
101
95
Deep Learning Research 
Sample Output:
A
